2.w: “I have heard many things like these before. What miserable comforters are you all!

3.w: Will there be an end to your windy words? Or what provokes you that you answer?

4.w: I also could speak like you, if you were in my place; I could pile up words against you, and I could shake my head at you.

5.w: But I would strengthen you with my words; comfort from my lips would bring you relief.

6.w: “But if I speak, my pain is not relieved, and if I refrain from speaking, how much of it goes away?

7.w: Surely now he has worn me out; you have devastated my entire household.

8.w: You have seized me, and it has become a witness; my leanness has risen up against me and testifies against me.

9.w: His anger has torn me and persecuted me; he has gnashed at me with his teeth; my adversary locks his eyes on me.

10.w: People have opened their mouths against me; they have struck my cheek in scorn; they unite together against me.

11.w: God abandons me to evil men, and throws me into the hands of wicked men.

12.w: I was in peace, and he has shattered me. He has seized me by the neck and crushed me. He has made me his target;

13.w: his archers surround me. Without pity he pierces my kidneys and pours out my gall on the ground.

14.w: He breaks through against me, time and time again; he rushes against me like a warrior.

15.w: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin and buried my horn in the dust;

16.w: my face is reddened because of weeping, and on my eyelids there is a deep darkness,

17.w: although there is no violence in my hands and my prayer is pure.

18.w: “O earth, do not cover my blood, nor let there be a secret place for my cry.

19.w: Even now my witness is in heaven; my advocate is on high.

20.w: My intercessor is my friend as my eyes pour out tears to God;

21.w: and he contends with God on behalf of man as a man pleads for his friend.

22.w: For the years that lie ahead are few, and then I will go on the way of no return.
